Sinusoidal or learned encoding for sequence positions.

Adds position information to Float32 [batch, sequence, d_model]: fixed sine/cosine values (sinusoidal, no parameters) or a learned table (learned, GPT-2).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Attention](../categories/attention.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `PositionalEncoding` |
| Search words | transformer, position, encoding, sequence |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Float32 sequence [batch, sequence, d_model]. |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Same-shape position-aware Float32 sequence. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Position | Model Width | `d_model` | Integer | `512` | `1-65536` | The run | Required input/output feature width. Required. |
| Position | Maximum Sequence Length | `max_sequence_length` | Integer | `5000` | `1-1048576` | The run | Largest accepted sequence length. With encoding_type=learned this is also the table size (max_sequence_length x d_model parameters): set it to the model's context length. Required. |
| Position | Encoding Type | `encoding_type` | Choice | `sinusoidal` | `sinusoidal`, `learned` | The run | sinusoidal: fixed sine/cosine values (original Transformer, no parameters). learned: a trainable position table initialized N(0, 0.02), as in GPT-2 and BERT. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled as a deterministic sequence-position model layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
This node is CPU-backed, has no trainable parameters, and preserves the input shape. Add it before the first attention block.
```

## Tips

- The input feature width must match d_model.
- This implementation does not apply dropout.
